entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6554"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 90</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.90.1-Ps.90.17">Psa 90:1-17</reference>. Contrasting man's frailty with God's eternity, the writer mourns over it as the punishment of sin, and prays for a return of the divine favor. A Prayer [mainly such] of Moses the man of God--(<reference osisRef="Deut.33.1">De 33:1</reference>; <reference osisRef="Josh.14.6">Jos 14:6</reference>); as such he wrote this (see on <reference osisRef="Ps.18.1">Psa 18:1</reference>, title, and <reference osisRef="Ps.36.1">Psa 36:1</reference>, title).</title> <div sID="gen10046" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6554"/><hi type="bold">1. dwelling-place--</hi>home (compare <reference osisRef="Ezek.11.16">Eze 11:16</reference>), as a refuge (<reference osisRef="Deut.33.27">De 33:27</reference>). <div eID="gen10046" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: PSALM 90 Psa 90:1-17 . Contrasting man's frailty with God's eternity, the writer mourns over it as the punishment of sin, and prays for a return of the divine favor. A Prayer [mainly such] of Moses the man of God--( De 33:1 ; Jos 14:6 ); as such he wrote this (see on Psa 18:1 , title, and Psa 36:1 , title). 1. dwelling-place-- home (compare Eze 11:16 ), as a refuge ( De 33:27 ).
